source: Gillon et al. (2016), Temperate Earth-sized planets transiting a nearby ultracool dwarf star, Nature 533, 221, Extended Data Table 2 (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5321506/)
band: TRAPPIST I+z, transmission greater than 90% from 750 nm to beyond 1100 nm; effective wavelength 885 +/- 5 nm
note: The paper inferred these coefficients from theoretical tables using the stellar gravity, metallicity and temperature. They were prior distributions in the transit fit, not a spatially resolved or independently measured photospheric limb. At mu = 0 the model intensity is 0.07 of the centre.
